q: (whatever Qur'aan has been revealed to you)
in the name of your Rabb Who created
v.s: Recite in the name of your Lord who created
v.c: Read, ˹O Prophet,˺ in the Name of your Lord Who created—

q: ...Who created man from a clot of blood
(which forms at conception and then develops into the child).
v.s: Created man from a clinging substance.
v.c: created humans from a clinging clot.

q: Read and your Rabb is most Magnanimous...
v.s: Recite, and your Lord is the most Generous -
v.c: Read! And your Lord is the Most Generous,

q: (However, even without any means like pens and books,)
taught man what he did not know.
(All man's knowledge comes from Allaah because Allaah gave man the means of acquiring knowledge as well.)
v.s: Taught man that which he knew not.
v.c: taught humanity what they knew not.

q: It is a fact that man
v.c: Most certainly, one exceeds all bounds
v.h: The Man Who Abused the Prophet

q: ...because he considers himself to be independent.
(This belief is foolish since man is dependant on the creation and is always dependent on Allaah.)
v.c: once they think they are self-sufficient.

q: (of every person on the Day of Qiyaamah)
v.s: Indeed, to your Lord is the return.
v.c: ˹But˺ surely to your Lord is the return ˹of all˺.

q: (Referring to Abu Jahal who was the arch-enemy of Rasulullaah ﷺ, Allaah says,)
Tell Me about the one who prevents...
v.s: Have you seen the one who forbids
v.c: Have you seen the man who prevents

q: Tell Me, what if the servant
v.s: Have you seen if he is upon guidance

q: (Ordinarily preventing anyone from worship is a terrible act, it is even worse when the one being prevented is a good person and the one preventing him is a sinful Kaafir.)
(from even listening to it)? (What will then become of him?)
v.s: Have you seen if he denies and turns away -
v.c: What if that ˹man˺ persists in denial and turns away?

q: Does he not know that Allaah is watching
(everything he does and will punish him for his evil)?
v.s: Does he not know that God sees?
v.c: Does he not know that Allah sees ˹all˺?

q: (but chooses to continue opposing Islaam and the Muslims),
v.s: No! If he does not desist, We will surely drag him by the forelock
v.c: But no! If he does not desist, We will certainly drag him by the forelock—

q: Then let him call his assembly
(of friends and associates to assist him).
v.s: Then let him call his associates;
v.c: So let him call his associates.

q: (people into Jahannam, referring to the angels of punishment stationed in Jahannam, each of whom is more powerful than all of mankind).
v.s: We will call the angels of Hell.
v.c: We will call the wardens of Hell.

q: (in the future just as you had never done in the past)!
(performing salaah without being intimidated by anyone)
(to Allaah). (One who recites or hears this verse being recited should perform Sajdah).
v.s: No! Do not obey him. But prostrate and draw near [to God].
v.c: Again, no! Never obey him ˹O Prophet˺! Rather, ˹continue to˺ prostrate and draw near ˹to Allah˺.
